# Camp items that buff Intelligence & XP and where to find them in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 17, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Apr 6, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cbbf99664bcd4a0eb4d563c8b96880f1~mv2.png)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi Models: Old Hag 43 and Swingkid

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack on top of buffs from food, chems, drinks, armour, etc.

You can not stack camp items that give the same buff ie Luck and Luck or Intelligence and Intelligence.

Camp item buffs will not stack on themselves.

__Mechanical Derby Game__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3956d9f189674eef81af11279037727f~mv2.jpg)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi Models: Old Hag 43 and Swingkid

**Buff:**

+2 Intelligence

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:** 

No

**Obtained via:**

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - 1250 Bullion

Season 9 Scoreboard - Heart of Steel - Free

**Build Menu Location:**

Misc. Tab

**Build Limit:**

3 per camp, shelter, or workshop

Shares a build limit with the Arm Wrestle Machine, Mechanical Derby Game, and Atlantic City Mechanical Derby Game

**Flamingo Units:**

1 Flamingo Unit

__Sacred Mothman Tome__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c5ebc7cd671d4c2c85cd71fc2fe2abcd~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

+5% XP

Does not stack with other Mothman XP buffs (Path to Enlightenment, Steven Scarberry, Mothman Equinox).

Can be stacked with Leo Petrov's Nuka-Inspiration: Cranberry Buff

**Lasts for:**

60 minutes

**Player animation:** 

Yes

**Obtained via:**

__Mothman Equinox__ Seasonal Event - Player Tradeable

**Build Menu Location:**

Floor Decor Tab

**Build Limit:**

None

**Flamingo Units:**

1 Flamingo Unit
